title: MinehutGateway
description: a simple mod to join subgenres on minehut based on keywords.
body:
A simple client sided mod to join minehut servers based on a simple keyword.

Commands
```
/getservers <keyword>: gets all the servers with that keyword
/joinrandom <keyword>: joins a random server that matches that keyword
```

for the /joinrandom command to work you must be in the minehut lobby.
